subject: humanities
passage: Every summer, the city of Kandy, Sri Lanka, holds the Esala Perahera, a festival that lasts about ten days and includes a series of nighttime processions. Each procession brings together three main groups of performers: drummers, who set the pace for the whole ______ dancers, whose costumes glitter with beads and silver ornaments; and elephants, many of them draped in embroidered cloth and strings of lights.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The colon introduces a list of three items, and each item already contains a comma ("drummers, who …" and "dancers, whose …"). When list items contain commas, semicolons separate the items, as the semicolon after "ornaments" shows. The same mark is needed after the first item.
explanation.A: Incorrect. Because the list items contain their own commas, a comma here would blur where the first item ends; semicolons must separate the items.
explanation.B: Correct. The semicolon separates the first list item from the second, matching the semicolon used between the second and third items.
explanation.C: Incorrect. A colon can introduce a list, but it can't separate one item in a list from the next.
explanation.D: Incorrect. With no punctuation, the first list item runs straight into the second.
